newsitem.title: USA: Porsche 1996 North American sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Porsche 1996 North American sales rise.

text.p: Porsche Cars North America and Porsche Cars Canada Ltd said Monday their combined 1996 U.S. and Canadian sales were 23 percent higher than the previous year.
The North American unit of Porsche AG said 1996 sales totalled 7,151 cars, a 23 percent increase over its 1995 figures.
The Canadian one said total 1996 sales were 372 units, a 20 percent gain over 1995.

The two units said the increases were due to "continued North American market acceptance of the new Porsche 911 line, which comprised virtually all of the new Porsches sold in the U.S. and Canada in 1996".
"Since their introduction in 1994, sales of the new 911 Carrera and its derivatives have nearly doubled Porsche's North American sales volume."
